notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: I read the complete held EO 9970 text (hash re-checked): it creates a Board of Inquiry under LMRA sec. 206, to report by June 23, 1948, and provides that after its report the Board continues to perform other functions under the Act until terminated by the President. Under the owner's report-deadline ruling the report date is a spent fact, not an end. The held TERM records are machine until-event/report-deadline leads, not an end; the only own-terms end is presidential termination, and no terminating instrument or notice is held. EO 9939 is merely cross-referenced as a separate dispute. The 1989 'executed and obsolete' row is a lead only. Cruden finds no later held order citing EO 9970. So neither NO nor YES is supported.
